verdict.rationale: Rollbar's public REST API reference says the same API is used by its official SDKs to report errors, exceptions, deploys and messages, so the ingestion endpoint itself is documented and open. The docs also note that the community has built SDKs for many more platforms, and that a post_client_item token scope exists specifically for sending events. Missing for 10: evidence of a documented occurrence payload schema, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes at the standard paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of a custom client sending events.
